environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance with IAM instance profile 'CommentServiceRole'. The role has full DynamoDB access to the UserComments table with no condition keys. The /cli/import endpoint is accessible on the internal network (VPC). No Content-Security-Policy headers are set. The application serves comments with '| safe' Jinja2 filter, rendering stored HTML/JS directly.

config.network: Internal VPC, no WAF, ALB forwards all traffic
